text:
oncall-bot: 🚨 SLO alert — cont-batch pool 'cb-core-3' reporting p95 latency spike and a KV-cache eviction storm. paging I/O spiking, paging-out errors rising. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/contbatch
maria.romero: ack, I'm on it. pulling traces and runtime logs now. attaching recent trace ids.
kevin: initial quick check shows a config drift in the last rollout. max_batch_tokens was accidentally set to 800000 (should be ~80k). continuous-batching is merging enormous prefixes -> kvcache blowups and heavy paging.
dinesh: that matches the OOM/paging symptoms. immediate mitigation: roll back to safe defaults and enforce max_num_seqs. propose: max_batch_tokens=131072, max_num_seqs=32, batch_timeout_ms=5 (aggressive but safe).
julie: prepping hotfix for prod. will push overrides and start canary on cb-core-3. applying now.
julie: deploy command I'm using:
```
POST /deploys/hotfix
{ "service": "cont-batch", "env": "prod", "overrides": { "max_batch_tokens": 131072, "max_num_seqs": 32, "batch_timeout_ms": 5 } }
```
ops-bot: deploy accepted. rollout strategy: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. monitoring on #contbatch-health.
maria.romero: also enabling temporary aggressive prefix eviction and limit kvcache entries per-prefix to avoid rebuild storm: set kv_cache.max_entries_per_prefix=64 for the pool.
kevin: adding short-term throttle: block/queue requests with request.sequence_length > 64000 tokens at the ingress layer to stop more huge batches from entering while we stabilize.
customer-success-bot: customers potentially impacted flagged: acct-3312, acct-5599, acct-7710. CS notified, drafting customer message; ETA 30m. observed ~5-10x latency spikes for calls from those accounts.
dinesh: running targeted kvcache purge for hot prefixes to relieve paging pressure:
```
# on cb-core-3
redwoodctl kvcache evict --prefix "session-*" --age-ms 60000
```
julie: canary telemetry: p95 latency dropped from ~4.2s to ~700ms after config overrides + eviction ✅. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/contbatch?panel=latency
maria.romero: paging IO and swap activity have reduced. keeping monitoring window open for 15m before relaxing throttles.
kevin: root cause notes: bad defaults merge in release pipeline bumped max_batch_tokens by 10x. will add CI guard to flag >2x jumps without explicit approval.
dinesh: follow-ups I recommend: runtime validation for max_batch_tokens, circuit breaker that trips on paging IO surge, automated rollback if kvcache eviction rate exceeds threshold.
maria.romero: handing off to oncall-next: @kevin you're on for the incident. summary for handoff: config overshoot -> kvcache blowup -> paging storm; mitigated via hotfix (max_batch_tokens=131072, max_num_seqs=32, batch_timeout_ms=5), aggressive eviction, and temporary throttles. monitor 1h then relax.
kevin: taking handoff. I'll keep alert thresholds low for 2h and coordinate with CS on outbound comms. assigning postmortem owner: @dinesh.
julie: filing timeline and notes into the incident doc. next steps: postmortem, CI guard, runtime sanity checks, make safe defaults immutable without explicit opt-in. :memo:
oncall-bot: incident status -> mitigated. SLOs recovering but not yet fully restored. next update in 30m.
